description: This file defines classes and methods for generating and managing pagination shapes in OrchardCore CMS, including shape descriptions, rendering logic, and URL parameter handling.

classes.name: PagerShapesTableProvider
classes.description: Provides shape table entries for pager shapes, configuring shape properties and alternates based on PagerId.

classes.name: PagerShapes
classes.description: Contains shape methods for rendering pager links, including full pagination controls and slim pager variants.

methods.name: DiscoverAsync
methods.description: Configures shape descriptions and alternates for various pager-related shapes.

methods.name: Pager_Links
methods.description: Renders a full pager with page links, previous/next, first/last, and gaps based on current page and total items.

methods.name: Pager
methods.description: Returns a shape for pager links with type 'Pager_Links'.

methods.name: PagerSlim
methods.description: Renders a simplified pager with previous and next controls.

methods.name: Pager_Link
methods.description: Renders a generic action link shape.

methods.name: ActionLink
methods.description: Creates an HTML anchor tag for a shape, with optional disabled state.

methods.name: Pager_Gap
methods.description: Renders a gap indicator ('...') in the pager.

methods.name: CoerceHtmlString
methods.description: Converts an object to IHtmlContent, wrapping strings or returning empty content.

methods.name: GetRouteData
methods.description: Collects route data from the current HTTP context and shape properties for URL generation.

methods.name: SetCustomUrlParams
methods.description: Adds custom URL parameters to route data for pager links.
